append.detail: FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-12 (2). The inbound bridge's member-facing Reply-To addresses (the legacy forward-and-send in routeHouseReplyOutbound and the atomic payload) now come from buildSpaceConversationReplyAddress, so a Space thread carries the Space alias on every member-facing send. The HOUSE address the operator replies to from their own inbox stays a Frequency-signed token on purpose: aliases carry the member role only, and the house route is what authenticates the operator. Send-path coverage is complete; the integrated pilot, owner revocation and retention remain.CI EVIDENCE 2026-10-12 (re-read, not new work). The pgTAP fixtures this row said were NOT RUN have been running on every pull request that touches supabase/: the required db-tests check boots a fresh local Postgres, applies every migration (all 810, the email ones included: 20270346007500 identity registry, 7600 atomic bridge intents, 7700 provider acceptance, 7800 domain operations, 8000 reply aliases) and runs supabase test db. Latest green run https://github.com/hellofrequencylab/frequency-web/actions/runs/37976955556 (2026-10-09, Files=67, Tests=1088, All tests successful): email_atomic_bridge_intents.test.sql (19 assertions), email_provider_acceptance.test.sql (18), space_email_identity_registry.test.sql (11), space_email_domain_operations.test.sql (8) and space_email_reply_aliases.test.sql (8) all ok, none skipped (scripts/pgtap-uncovered.txt lists only the safeupdate file). So the isolated migration replay and the RLS, grant, service-role and RPC consequences those fixtures assert are proven in CI, and the stale "local database unavailable" evidence is withdrawn. What pgTAP cannot show stays open: independent-connection races, the live provider pilot (an owner-triggered authenticated send and reply on the Daniel Tyack Space, then a second-Space isolation check), and owner revocation or retention runs. The eight alias assertions ran against the full historical schema in CI, which answers the reduced-dependency-schema caveat; the issuance switch stays OFF until the pilot.
